label: Diagram 7
caption: Diagram 7 Handrail design
description: The drawing, titled Diagram 7 Handrail design, consists of two sections. The upper section shows a wall on the left with two handrail cross-sections. The left profile is a circle labelled "Circular handrail 32mm to 50mm diameter", with a horizontal dimension of "50mm to 75mm" from the wall to the edge of the circular handrail. The right profile is a rounded shape labelled "Non-circular handrail 50mm wide and 39mm deep having rounded edges", with a "15mm min. radius" indicated at the corner. A vertical dimension of "50mm min." is shown between the two cross-sections, to the right of the circular handrail. The lower section shows a handrail on a post standing on a horizontal surface with a vertical edge, the edge being labelled "Ramped or stepped access". A horizontal dimension of "50mm max." runs from the edge of the access to the centre of the handrail, and a vertical dimension of "50mm min." runs from the base to the bottom of the handrail.
